2026 Corn Discount Schedule (10/01/2026)
#2 Yellow Corn
Discount Rates:
Test Weight:                  52.0-53.9 lbs-       2 cents/bu each lb
                              50.0-51.9 lbs-       3 cents/bu each lb
                              43.0-49.9 lbs-       4 cents/bu each lb
                              Below 42.9 lbs-      5 cents/bu each lb
                              Subject to rejection below 45 lbs

Moisture:                     15.1-17%            8 cents/bu+3 cents/bu each half percent
                              17.1-18.5%          19 cents/bu+2 cents/bu each half percent
                              18.6%+              24 cents/bu+1 cent/bu each half percent
                              Additional 6 cents per bushel in Sheldon and Marathon if over 15%
                              25% and above subject to rejection

Shrink:                       Sold Bu                    0.75% each 1/2 % above 15.0%
                              Stored Bu                  0.75% each 1/2 % above 14.0 %

Foreign Material:             3.1% and above             3 cents/bu each %

Damage:                       5.1%-10.0%         3 cents/bu each %
                              10.1%-15.0%        5 cents/bu each %
                              15.1% and above    Please Call
                              10% and above subject to rejection

Storage & DP:                 5 cents/bu/month storage
                              4 cents/bu/month Deferred Pricing (price by 07/31/2027)
                              Moisture shrink begins at 14.1%

Out Charge:                   14 cents per bushel

Musty:                        10 cents (Subject to Rejection)
Sour:                         10 cents (Subject to Rejection)
COFO:                         20 cents (Subject to Rejection)
Infested:                     10 cents (Subject to Rejection)

*River Country Cooperative reserves the right to decline the purchase of any product at its operatives discretion.
*River Country Cooperative reserve the right to take grain in-lieu-of unpaid drying and storage charges.
*All grain accounts will be settled before check is issued or before removal of all grain.
